gen-flavors-gf-fresca: Stubby, grinning, loud. Fresca follows in a plain sans with open apertures and short ascenders, giving Flavors' towering lowercase room to be the show.
gen-flavors-gf-funnel-sans: Whimsical Flavors puts up diagonals as hefty as its stems, while Funnel Sans keeps its strokes steady and its e pried wide open. The pairing's best trait is that bold-versus-tidy split.
gen-flavors-gf-gafata: Chunky and cheerful, Flavors towers over Gafata, whose sans-serif letters sit in a tall band beneath short stalks. Gafata reads smoothly and comfortably over long stretches.
gen-flavors-gf-geist: Flavors arrives with towering, pencil-stub lowercase. Geist answers in sans that sets words as solid blocks with a quiet, level beat, and that gap in temperament is the pair's best quality.
gen-flavors-gf-georama: Every stroke in Flavors is one thickness, and the lowercase towers. Georama follows in a plain sans with a bracelet-wide c and low capitals, so the heading gets the stage and the text stays friendly.
gen-flavors-gf-gidole: Gidole reads in tidy, neon-tube strokes with terminals parted like scissor blades and a high-set midline. Shrink Flavors down and its whimsy would lose its swagger.
gen-flavors-gf-golos-text: Flavors has towering lowercase, like a stubby carpenter's pencil stroke, and that is its signature. Golos Text counters with a sans-serif x-height that fills the line, so the two stay lively without fighting.
gen-flavors-gf-hedvig-letters-sans: Flavors keeps one constant stroke from top to baseline. Hedvig Letters Sans, a sans-serif with a clear gap in its c, would probably look best at a modest size beneath it.
gen-flavors-gf-heebo: Flavors holds one thickness in every stroke, with a towering lowercase that grabs attention. And Heebo, a sans-serif with a tall central band and curves that stop short, handles the quiet work of carrying text.
gen-flavors-gf-hind-guntur: Flavors is all whimsy and towering lowercase. Hind Guntur, a plain sans, offers wide gaps at curve ends and cable-like strokes, so Flavors can show off while Hind Guntur does the steady reading.
